title: Transient session handoff duplication after node downgrade causing duplicate metering tokens
creator: Sofia Martinez
description: Summary: Several enterprise Private and Dedicated customers reported unexpected duplicate token charges after a scheduled node class downgrade (power-saver) in certain regions. Investigations show transient session handoffs during the downgrade window caused duplicated metering events for the same logical request when the serving node and proxy reported overlapping session state. This ticket tracks the investigation, short-term mitigations, and a production fix.
description_details:
Symptoms observed:
- Customers A (private cluster) and B (dedicated) reported +1.6%-4.3% token spikes for short windows coincident with maintenance windows on 2026-03-09 UTC.
- Ledger diffs show duplicate token rows with identical request fingerprint but different session_id and node_id.
- Spike aligns with node downgrade window where pods were restarted with reduced resources (power-saver mode).
Reproduction steps (dev environment):
1) Start two proxied serving nodes and establish a long-running streaming session.
2) Trigger node downgrade/rolling restart on node A (simulate low-priority resource eviction) while allowing session handoff to node B.
3) Send a sequence of streaming tokens with short inter-token intervals and intentionally delay acks from the proxy to cause overlap.
4) Observe two metering events emitted: one from node A with partial token count and one from node B with the remainder; both include the same request fingerprint because the session continuation logic re-used the request id while generating a new session_id.
Root cause hypothesis:
- The handoff path rehydrates KV cache and reuses the original request fingerprint but also issues a new session_id. The metering pipeline currently dedupes on a composite of (request_fingerprint, node_id, session_id) which allows a duplicate when session_id changes and node_id changes quickly.
- During resource-constrained downgrades, the proxy's ACK path can lag; the original node retries accounting events on eventual commit while the new node emits accounting for resumed tokens.
- Private clusters with older metering-export plugins are especially susceptible because they batch and then emit after restart, widening the duplication window.
Impact & scope:
- Affected customers: 3 reported, estimated 18 customers in fleet may have experienced transient effects during similar maintenance windows.
- Financial exposure: estimated cumulative duplicate credits ~ $1.2k (preliminary).
- Secondary effects: manual support escalations, invoice adjustments, customer trust/time spent on reconciliation.
mitigation:
Short-term mitigations deployed 2026-03-10:
- Disable aggressive accounting retries on commit for edge handoff path (feature-flagged) to reduce duplicate re-emits.
- For private clusters, ship a hotfix to the metering exporter that dedupes pending batched rows by request_fingerprint for 72 hours post-restart.
- Proactive outreach: CS notified impacted accounts with temporary credit and ETA for permanent fix.
proposed_fix:
1) Change metering dedupe key to use a stable handoff_id generated at session start and persisted in the KV cache; ensure both old and new nodes read/write the same handoff_id for the logical request.
2) Add idempotent write semantics to ledger ingestion: server will include handoff_id + monotonic sequence to allow ingestion dedupe.
rollout_plan:
Phase 1 (staging): patch runtime to persist handoff_id and unit tests for streaming handoff dedupe (2 days).
Phase 2 (canary): deploy to 10% of hosted nodes + one Dedicated pool during low-traffic window (monitor for duplicate emits) (1 day).
Phase 3 (private): publish hotpatch and runbook for upgrade operators; coordinate with 2 high-risk private customers for manual rollout.
Phase 4: global rollout and deprecation of old retry behavior.
Backout: revert to feature-flagged state and re-enable accounting retries if a regression causes undercounting.
qa_plan:
- Unit tests: simulate handoff scenarios with overlapping acks and assert single metering event.
- Integration: run end-to-end on staging with synthetic customers and assert ledger idempotency.
- Migration test: perform a rolling restart on a dedicated cluster running previous exporter and ensure no duplicates post-upgrade.
- Performance: confirm no measurable latency increase in commit path (<2ms p50 change).
monitoring_and_alerting:
Add metrics and dashboards:
- meter.handoff.duplicates.count (by region, node, cluster-type).
- meter.handoff.latency.quantiles.
- ledger.ingest.dedupe_rate.
Set alerts: >0.1% duplicate rate over 5m for any customer with >1k tokens/min.
Add an automated reconcile job that flags customers with uncommonly high duplicate ratios for manual review.
postmortem_actions:
- Add upstream unit+integration tests for handoff dedupe.
- Update maintenance runbook to set 'accounting-safety-mode' flag during downgrades.
- Ship a tooling script to reconcile ledgers and auto-apply small corrective credits when duplicates detected.
- Schedule customer-focused billing audit for impacted customers and expedite invoice corrections.
